test_reindex_like: test the Series.reindex_like method to reindex with another Series index
test_reindex_like_pad: test Series.reindex_like with method='pad' to forward-fill missing values
test_reindex_like_nearest: test Series.reindex_like with method='nearest' for nearest-neighbor reindexing
test_reindex_like_tolerance: test Series.reindex_like with method='nearest' and tolerance parameter to limit match distance
test_reindex_like_tolerance_list: test Series.reindex_like with method='nearest' and per-element tolerance list
